- Assign scores ranging from 1 (Very Bad) to 5 (Very Good) for style control, semantic preservation, and fluency.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. Paper focuses on Text Style Transfer evaluation using both automatic metrics and human evaluation. Main contributions include DisenTrans framework for disentangled style transfer with synthetic data generation using LLMs. Human evaluation was comprehensive with clear criteria.
